entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return an item. Order number 788-B45-119.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see it's for the Road Cycling Shoes. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't work for me. They're causing horrible blisters on my heels, no matter how I adjust the cleats. I just want my money back.

I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want you to have. Let me just confirm the delivery date... I see they were delivered 52 days ago.
Right. So can I return them or not?

Yes, absolutely. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, so you are well within that timeframe. I can process a full refund for you right now. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label as we speak.
Okay, good. So I just print the label and drop it off?

That's correct. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
